title: The Abbey's Receipt
summary: Brother Anselm keeps his shelves by an index, every book by shelf and place. Somewhere among them is his own copy of the receipt for the Grey Fever.
question: Find the cure's page by Anselm's index. Where is the receipt?

clues.note: The fever books: the dead by parish, the remedies tried and failed, and in the last book the one that worked.
A novice's copy of a herbal, stopped mid-sentence in the chapter on fever-root.

Anselm's index, every book by shelf and place. Shelf II: herbals; II.4, the herbal under copy, fever-root at leaf thirty-one. Shelf III: the Grey Fever, one book to a year, III.1 the first year to III.7 the last, each year's receipts bound in at the twelfth leaf. Shelf IV: chronicles of the house. Saints' days below, in the undercroft.

options.label: Shelf II, the fourth book, leaf thirty-one
Shelf III, the seventh book, leaf twelve

wrong.ii_4_leaf_31: The herbal has fever-root and only fever-root. The root alone is only comfort.
wrong.iii_1: The first fever book is the dead by parish and the remedies that failed.
wrong.iv_chronicle: The chronicle rings the bells for the fever years and says nothing of how it was cured.

hints.text: The fever books say the last one recorded the remedy that worked.
A receipt is a page, not a book. The index gives a leaf.

solved_summary: found Brother Anselm's receipt for the Grey Fever on his shelves by its index: fever-root steeped with Greystone's deep-vein salt
